articles.title: Chainlink teams up with 47 South Korean, European banks to speed up international money transfers
articles.snippet: The alliance, called Project Pangea, plans to use stablecoins to settle multimillion-dollar currency trades between Europe and South Korea in near real time.

articles.title: Multi-year Bitcoin holder selling falls to 19-month low as halving model flags new market bottom date
articles.snippet: OG Bitcoin holders' spending dropped to a 19-month low, as market cycle indicators point to September as a potential market bottom.

articles.title: Kalshi adds India to growing list of restricted jurisdictions
articles.snippet: Kalshi has added India to its list of 55 restricted jurisdictions, months after Indian authorities warned VPN providers to stop facilitating access to these platforms.

articles.title: Former BIS chief softens stance on stablecoins, backs coexistence with fiat
articles.snippet: Former BIS general manager Agustín Carstens said stablecoins can enhance financial inclusion and innovation but stressed the need for global regulatory frameworks to enable coexistence with fiat money.

articles.title: THORChain resumes trading more than month after $10M exploit
articles.snippet: THORChain resumed all network activity after implementing multiple security upgrades and a vault migration to fix the vulnerabilities that led to the $10.7 million exploit.
